articles.summary: NEW YORK, April 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SunCar Technology Group Inc. (the "Company" or "SunCar") (NASDAQ: SDA), a leader in digitalizing auto insurance and services in China, has won the contract to manage all concierge chauffeur services for the Agricultural Bank of China (“AgBank”).
articles.title: SunCar Wins Major Bid to Manage Agricultural Bank of China’s Concierge Chauffeur Services
